subject: Governance asks + deck lock request (QBR materials)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Governance asks + deck lock request (QBR materials)

Team —

I need to lock the investor/board deck for the QBR distribution next Wednesday EOD PT. Two quick asks before I request the board mailbox lock:

1) Governance slide: we added the new audit timeline and SOC-2 items on slide 4. Legal flagged two sentences that might be prematurely specific about retention windows — see comments in the attached doc. Please confirm by EOD today whether we can leave the retention language as-is or switch to the safer phrasing I suggested in the doc.

2) Exec summary: Jonas, can you confirm the runway / unit economics bullet (slide 2) — I tightened the wording to avoid revenue projections but want your sign-off that it still reflects ops numbers.

Attached: QBR_board_deck_v3.pptx (deck), QBR_governance_asks_v2.docx (redline)

Plan: if we have sign-off by EOD today I will:
- upload a final PDF to the board Drive folder
- request the board mailbox lock and notify Board Admin to schedule distribution

If there are open items after EOD, I propose a 30-minute sync tomorrow morning (10:00 PT) to finalize.

Thanks —

Priya Natarajan
Chief of Staff, Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0121

----

Note: draft language highlighted in the attached governance doc.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Governance asks + deck lock request (QBR materials)

Priya —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes inline and below.

On retention language (slide 4 / governance doc): legal is right — the previous text could imply a hard retention window. Please switch to: "We are implementing data retention policies aligned with customer contracts and applicable law; details available to auditors on request." That keeps us out of commitments while answering the board question.

On the runway bullet (slide 2): I approve the tightened wording but suggest adding a parenthetical reference: (cash runway calculation excludes one-time migration credits). That prevents confusion if finance is asked in the Q&A.

Two small edits for the deck:
- Slide 6 (Ops improvements): swap the order of the two bullets — show latency wins before cost wins.
- Slide 9 (Risks): add a line about model supply risk (external model maintenance timelines).

I can join the 10:00 PT slot tomorrow if needed.

—Jonas
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the heads up and for sharing the updated materials. The board mailbox team can distribute the deck on Wednesday as requested. Two items from our side:

1) Please upload the final PDF to the shared Drive folder (link below) by Tuesday 8:00 PT so we can run the security scan.
2) We need a single page "ask summary" (bullet form) that lists approvals being requested of the board (e.g., retrospective compliance reporting window, grant of an audit scope exception). If you can attach that to the final PDF, great — otherwise send as a standalone PDF.

If you upload by the time above we will schedule distribution for Wednesday 10:00 ET / 07:00 PT.
